sentence_stem: Despite the rapid growth of online learning,
correct_completion: many universities still require in-person exams.
full_sentence: Despite the rapid growth of online learning, many universities still require in-person exams.
acceptable_variants: many universities still keep in-person exams.
in-person exams remain common at many universities.

options.text: so most students chose to study at home.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, but 'despite' requires a contrast with the growth mentioned in the stem.

options.text: online learning is now popular in every country.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of growth instead of contrasting with it, so it does not complete the 'despite' pattern.

options.text: many universities still require in-person exams.
the growth caused a rise in exam fees.
options.why_wrong: This presents the growth as a cause, which contradicts the contrast signalled by 'despite'.

grammar_focus: Concessive 'despite' with a nominalized noun phrase
explanation: 'Despite' introduces a contrast with the noun phrase that follows it, so the main clause must show something that goes against the growth. The verb 'grow' has been turned into the noun 'growth', a typical feature of academic style.
translation: A pesar del rápido crecimiento del aprendizaje en línea, muchas universidades todavía exigen exámenes presenciales.
